final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zone, s.entrystat AS entry, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / p.proccpu) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entry, AVG(avg_mem), AVG(avg_ratio) FROM s1 GROUP BY entry
